Madhab Chandra Das College, now a name in 
				the arena of learning stands at a spot rich in charming natural 
				serenity and grace that was conducted to arouse aesthetic 
				pleasure. Rural Sonai area comprises the huge plot of land from 
				Bhuban Hill to Sonabarighat and from Binnakandi to Palonghat. 
				But this bigger area is devoid of an institution of higher 
				education and therefore the local students had to opt for the 
				two Colleges of Silchar namely Gurucharan College and Cachar 
				College. Most of the guardians with meager income could not 
				afford to send their wards to Silchar and the wards of few 
				affordable guardians had most often to come back despaired 
				because of failure to get admitted to the desired Colleges. It 
				appeared as a grave problem for the area as a whole and it 
				attracted the attention of some noble minds of the area. They 
				came forward to effect a permanent solution of the problem. On 
				one sunny morning in the early seventies of the last century 
				those altruistic social servants attended by a section of common 
				people of the area got together and after thorough discussion 
				and exchange of views the historic resolution of setting up a 
				College, the dire need of the hour, was unanimously adopted. The 
				long-standing dream of the people of the area, thus, was on its 
				way to fructification.

STATUTORY WARNING AGAINST 
			RAGGING
COLLEGE SONG
This is for information of all the students and guardians that 
				Ragging is strictly prohibited in the institution.
Anyone found guilty of ragging and / or abetting ragging, 
				whether actively or passively, or being a part of a conspiracy 
				of promote ragging, is liable to be punished in accordance with 
				the U.G.C. Regulations on Curbing the Menace of Ragging in 
				Higher Educational Institutions, 2009 (under section 26(1) (g) 
				of the University Grants Commission Act 1956).
The institution shall take action in accordance with these 
				regulations against those found guilty of ragging and / or 
				abetting ragging, whether actively or passively, or being a part 
				of a conspiracy of promote ragging.
Soon after the admission, the students shall be informed through 
				a notification about the composition of Institutional 
				anti-Ragging Committee. The names of the members of the 
				committee and their telephone numbers shall also be notified. In 
				case of any incidence of ragging, the fresher shall immediately 
				contact any member of the committee and report the matter to 
				him/her.
